scope.scientific_question: How to build and validate a datum-bearing posterior for the present-day local density and velocity fields before using an IC as the downstream physical closure.
scope.primary_product: posterior samples of the z=0 matter density and peculiar-velocity fields with calibrated global and ROI-dependent effective resolution
scope.IC_role: downstream proposal and physical-closure variable only after the z=0 likelihood route passes development mocks

authorization.basis: The user approved completion of the datum-bearing z=0 density-likelihood design audit on 2026-09-01.

bindings.role: actual galaxy rows from which the count datum must be built
reusable raw selection and eight-subpoint voxel quadrature path
reusable development seed schedule and CF4 velocity mock components, not a 2M++ count mock generator

audit_findings.what_recent_Fisher_jobs_did: They evaluated expected information under homogeneous Gaussianized-Poisson designs; they did not bin the observed 36,635 galaxies and did not evaluate a galaxy-count likelihood.
audit_findings.exact_Fisher_terminal_decision: Do not execute the 64-geometry production for the unchanged linear Fisher design because the exact normalization-marginalized one-geometry material gate failed. This is not a rejection of a datum-bearing nonlinear count likelihood.
reusable_assets: official NSIDE=512 RING angular completeness maps in the verified equatorial convention
six tracer populations and Schechter radial response
two-point Gauss quadrature per voxel axis, giving eight subpoints per voxel
CF4 grouped velocity likelihood operators and development/validation seed firewall
non_reusable_as_is: The Fisher expected_counts arrays are normalized to the observed population totals and must not be used as a Poisson intensity.
The empirical CF4 grouped-velocity population generator is not a six-population 2M++ count generator.
An unconstrained 1+b*delta intensity can become negative and is forbidden.
A fixed Carrick density cube is a smoothed qualitative reference, not an exact count datum or truth field.
The current N32 linear Gaussian truths cannot calibrate nonlinear RSD, FoG, HOD, or model discrepancy for a final resolution claim.

scientific_route_decision.selected_route: CF4 velocities plus actual 2M++ counts to a z=0 density/velocity posterior, followed by IC inference or IC-conditioned physical closure and PM forward validation
scientific_route_decision.rejected_immediate_route: Return directly to low-k IC candidate selection before constructing a datum-bearing z=0 likelihood
scientific_route_decision.reason: The requested observable product is the present-day field. It can be tested directly on count and velocity mocks, while an IC-first candidate screen can hide failure behind random high-k modes and a later forward map.
scientific_route_decision.posterior_factorization: p(eta_z0,v_z0,theta | N_2Mpp,D_CF4) proportional to p_z0(eta_z0,v_z0) L_CF4(D_CF4 | v_z0,theta_CF4) product_{p,i} Poisson(N_{p,i} | lambda_{p,i}(eta_z0,v_z0,theta_2Mpp)) p(theta)
scientific_route_decision.z0_pilot_prior: At N32 only, use a whitened joint z=0 density/velocity prior with delta=exp(eta-sigma_eta^2/2)-1 and the frozen LCDM large-scale covariance. This is a technical likelihood pilot, not the final nonlinear model.
scientific_route_decision.nonlinear_closure_after_mock_pass: Replace or augment the technical z=0 prior with a differentiable PM forward model from an IC latent while retaining z=0 density and velocity as the primary reported posterior products.

actual_datum_contract.source_policy: Re-read the SHA-bound 2M++ catalog and exactly reproduce the frozen CF4-overlap, ZoA, cloned-redshift, radial, magnitude, and 319-recno metadata-consistency exclusions. Do not create a new outcome-dependent subset.
actual_datum_contract.coordinate_frame: supergalactic Cartesian, observer at the periodic box center
actual_datum_contract.position_semantics: observed redshift-space radius from Vcmb under the frozen cosmology, with sky direction transformed from the verified ICRS catalog coordinates
actual_datum_contract.voxel_assignment: NGP/floor assignment into exactly one voxel per retained row

holdout.rule: deterministic Bernoulli-like hash of recno and a precommitted salt
holdout.reason: Row thinning preserves the Poisson thinning interpretation and avoids a spatial-voxel split that leaks selection and nearby structure.

identity_gates: all arrays have exact shape and dtype
counts_all equals counts_train plus counts_holdout elementwise
each population sum equals its frozen population count
every retained recno occurs once and every excluded recno occurs zero times
every occupied index is inside the N32 box

selection_response_contract.angular: official ARES/BORG NSIDE=512 RING maps sampled in the verified equatorial convention after mapping the supergalactic voxel quadrature coordinates back to ICRS
selection_response_contract.radial: six-population Schechter response with Mstar=-23.28 and alpha=-0.94 under the frozen cosmology and magnitude cuts
selection_response_contract.voxel_integration: two-point Gauss quadrature on each axis, eight subpoints per voxel
selection_response_contract.forbidden_normalization: Do not normalize the selection field so that its expected-count sum equals the observed population count. The six population normalizations are likelihood nuisance parameters.
selection_response_contract.selection_only_baseline: six independent normalization parameters times the raw exposure, with density response fixed to zero
selection_response_contract.zero_exposure_rule: a positive observed count in a zero-exposure voxel is a hard datum-builder failure

positive_count_likelihood.baseline_distribution: independent Poisson counts conditional on the latent intensity
positive_count_likelihood.intensity_equation: lambda[p,i] = integral_{s in voxel_i} R_p(s;phi_p) integral dx K_p(s|x,v_z0(x),sigma_FoG_p,sigma_z_p) exp(alpha_p + b_p eta_z0(x))
positive_count_likelihood.positivity: exp(alpha_p+b_p*eta) and positive selection/RSD kernels guarantee lambda>=0; every voxel with an observed count must have lambda>0
positive_count_likelihood.RSD_kernel_normalization: For every real-space source location and population, integral ds K_p(s|x,...)=1 before the survey selection is applied.
positive_count_likelihood.coherent_RSD: The kernel mean includes the line-of-sight displacement induced by the predicted z=0 peculiar velocity.
positive_count_likelihood.small_scale_RSD: Population-specific positive FoG/group-dispersion and redshift-error scales broaden the line-of-sight kernel.
positive_count_likelihood.mass_conservation_test: With R_p=1 and a box-safe synthetic field, the total intensity is conserved by the real-to-redshift-space operator to the declared numerical tolerance.
positive_count_likelihood.negative_binomial_role: predeclared stress/alternative model only; it may replace Poisson only after development-mock evidence and before validation is opened

nuisance_hierarchy.population_normalization: six independent alpha_p parameters with external luminosity-function/selection calibration priors; a universal normalization is forbidden
nuisance_hierarchy.galaxy_bias: six positive b_p parameters, represented on a log scale; soft luminosity dependence may be used but no universal scalar is allowed
nuisance_hierarchy.selection_calibration: low-dimensional angular and radial calibration templates with external priors, never a free per-voxel field
nuisance_hierarchy.RSD_FoG: six positive small-scale velocity-dispersion parameters plus frozen or calibrated redshift-error terms
nuisance_hierarchy.overdispersion_HOD: disabled in the matched Poisson arm and enabled only in the declared stress arm or a frozen post-development alternative
nuisance_hierarchy.model_discrepancy: a shrinkage-regularized smooth log-intensity term may be tested in the stress arm; it must not absorb arbitrary cosmological modes
nuisance_hierarchy.CF4_overlap: The 17,007 non-unmatched 2M++ targets remain excluded from the density count factor. CF4 group marks remain canonical. Reintroduction would require a new shared-latent/covariance design and is forbidden in v1.
nuisance_hierarchy.identifiability: Report posterior rank, alpha-bias-selection correlations, Hessian or Fisher singular values near the mode, and chain diagnostics before any field claim.

untouched_validation.purpose: one-time validation only after the likelihood and all gates are frozen

development_mock_contract.minimum_truth_model_for_sampler_smoke: matched N32 log-density Poisson generator using one existing development seed
development_mock_contract.minimum_truth_model_for_science_calibrat: evolve the same predeclared seeds with PMWD on a generator grid finer than the N32 inference grid, then generate the six tracer populations and bin to N32
development_mock_contract.TNG100_role: inform local HOD, luminosity-bias, overdispersion, and FoG nuisance distributions only; it is too small to provide 384 cMpc/h low-k truth or cosmic variance

stress_arms.truth: matched positive Poisson log-intensity in real space
positive Poisson intensity with coherent RSD
coherent RSD plus population-dependent FoG and redshift errors
overdispersed/HOD counts with selection perturbations and smooth model discrepancy

development_mock_contract.eight_mock_assignment: Use seeds 2026083000 through 2026083007 exactly once, two per stress arm. Reuse seed 2026083000 from the smoke rather than generating another truth.
development_mock_contract.sixty_four_mock_assignment: Use all 64 development seeds exactly once, 16 per stress arm including the first eight.

staged_program.work: design and static contract tests only
implement the deterministic actual-datum builder and run one Slurm CPU validation that publishes the six integer count grids, raw selection exposure, row/split manifest, hashes, and COMPLETE marker
one matched development-mock differentiable smoke: exact likelihood/gradient checks, positive intensity, RSD conservation, optimization, and short non-scientific sampler mechanics
eight-mock balanced development pilot with four chains per mock, all four stress arms, heldout prediction, posterior predictive checks, and nuisance-identifiability diagnostics
64-development-mock calibration, final likelihood choice, resolution-frontier gate freeze, and resource estimate from measured MaxRSS plus at least 20 percent
staged_program.resources: not authorized and must be recalculated from Phase B/C measurements

staged_program.work: one-time 256-mock independent validation of the frozen likelihood and k-frontier gates
infer the actual z=0 density/velocity posterior, first at the validated coarse resolution and then through the separately approved multiresolution ladder
infer or condition ICs, PM-forward them, and require reproduction of the z=0 posterior and predeclared structures without seed selection

Phase_A_hard_gates: all identity gates in actual_datum_contract pass
raw selection exposure is finite and lies in [0,1]
no positive count has zero exposure
train and holdout row manifests are disjoint and exhaustive
all input and output hashes are published
no field inference or mock seed access occurs
Phase_B_technical_gates: all evaluated lambda values are finite and nonnegative, and positive wherever counts are positive
analytic/autodiff gradients agree with finite differences on predeclared directional probes
RSD forward and adjoint tests pass
RSD mass conservation passes with unit selection
no NaN, invalid log probability, or sampler state corruption
short-chain output is labeled mechanics-only and cannot support a science promotion
Phase_C_and_D_required_reports: four-chain rank-normalized R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS, divergence fraction, and energy diagnostics
nuisance posterior rank and alpha-bias-selection-RSD correlation structure
heldout log predictive density relative to the six-normalization selection-only baseline
posterior predictive count histogram, zero fraction, one-point PDF, radial counts, angular completeness residuals, P(k), 2PCF, redshift-space monopole, and quadrupole by population
truth response, cross-correlation, residual power, posterior variance reduction, and 68/95 percent coverage for density and velocity globally and in each frozen ROI
separate results for every stress arm; no indiscriminate pooling
diagnostics_and_gates.heldout_core_rule: Before Phase D results are inspected, freeze a bootstrap procedure for the heldout log-predictive-density difference. The selection-only baseline must be beaten with a strictly positive lower confidence bound; point improvement alone is insufficient.
diagnostics_and_gates.required_gate_amendment: Before Phase D and before opening validation, reconcile cf4_science_route_v3 and cf4_kf_bin_manifest_design_v1 into one coherent predictive, coverage, and resolution-frontier contract. This amendment must be committed before Phase D outcomes are inspected.

resolution_and_low_high_boundary_policy.boundary_rule: The observationally constrained frontier is the highest contiguous k-bin from low k that passes the frozen mock coverage, heldout-prediction, posterior-variance, and residual-calibration gates in the relevant global or ROI domain.
resolution_and_low_high_boundary_policy.multiresolution_ladder: After N32 likelihood validation, increase density and forward-model resolution in separately approved stages. A 384 cMpc/h full box requires at least N=1280 for 0.3 cMpc/h cells; a power-of-two full grid would use N=2048, so a validated coarse global field plus predeclared zoom refinements is the preferred cost-aware route.
resolution_and_low_high_boundary_policy.high_k_beyond_observational_frontier: Draw from the LCDM conditional prior and constrain further with explicitly modeled Local Group and other small-scale observations. Do not label those modes CF4- or 2M++-measured.
resolution_and_low_high_boundary_policy.0p3_claim: A numerical cell size at or below 0.3 cMpc/h is required for the final IC/zoom product, but the observational effective resolution may remain coarser and must be reported from mocks.

known_risks_and_required_controls.control: six independent normalizations and biases, external priors, heldout prediction, and rank/correlation diagnostics
explicit mass-conserving real-to-redshift-space kernel with coherent velocity, FoG, and redshift-error terms

known_risks_and_required_controls.risk: selection calibrated on the same counts
known_risks_and_required_controls.control: use the raw official response and external calibration priors; never renormalize exposure to the observed totals

known_risks_and_required_controls.risk: model passes matched mocks but erases filaments under misspecification
known_risks_and_required_controls.control: PMWD-based higher-resolution truth and RSD/FoG/HOD/selection stress arms, with P(k), 2PCF, multipoles, and one-point posterior predictive checks

known_risks_and_required_controls.risk: repeated tuning on the validation set or seed selection
known_risks_and_required_controls.control: 64/256 firewall, no seed ranking, one-time validation, and commit the gates before opening validation

known_risks_and_required_controls.risk: claiming 0.3 cMpc/h because of cell size alone
known_risks_and_required_controls.control: report numerical cell size and mock-calibrated observational frontier separately
